generation.explanation: In y = A sin(B(x − C)) + D, A is the amplitude (vertical stretch), B sets the frequency (the period is 2π/B), C is the phase shift (horizontal slide), and D is the vertical shift (the midline). Move the sliders to see each one change the wave. The dashed reference sine, y = sin(x), stays in place so you can compare.
